info.cls_ename: Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 介紹科技管理的概念，包括有國際競爭環境、科技規劃及預測、創新管理、新產品行銷、研發管理、縮短研發時間工具、高科技品質政策、專案管理、科技與法律。
description.describe_eh: Technology is a key resource of profound importance for corporate profitability and growth. It also has enormous significance for the well-being of national economies as well as international competitiveness .This course ,hence ,aims to introduce the concepts of technology management .It concludes the national competitive environment ,technology planning and forecasting ,managing innovation ,creating the innovative organization ,new products and international marketing ,research and development management ,tools for reducing R&D lead-time ,quality policy of high technology, projects management, technology and laws are introduced .Lectures and examples are used to equip students with knowledge.

targets.describe_ch: 能用自己的詞句定義何謂科技管理，能夠描述科技管理內容。
targets.describe_en: Define management of technology with their own words：Be able to describe the contents of technology management.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解科技發展速度與廣度的重要性以及工商業主要的典範轉移。
targets.describe_en: Understand the importance of considering both the speed and the scope of change in technological development and the consequential paradigm shift in the industrial and business enterprise system.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解技術創新的流程及能說明技術及產品生命週期的概念。
targets.describe_en: Understand the process of technological innovation and be able to explain the concepts of technology and product life cycles.

targets.describe_ch: 能以說面或口頭方式將所獲結果與同學及教師溝通。
targets.describe_en: Communicate results in written or oral form to classmates and the instructor.
